newsitem.title: USA: US MMS wants more accurate OCS natgas reporting.
newsitem.headline: US MMS wants more accurate OCS natgas reporting.

text.p: The U.S. Minerals Management Service Thursday proposed that Outer Continental Shelf oil and natural gas operations provide more information on gas sales volumes and qualities for accurate royalties payments.

The MMS wants a program to verify gas sales volumes, qualities and royalties payments, but said it must change its regulations because companies currently are not required to submit the data needed to ensure accurate measurements and reporting of OCS gas production.
"MMS needs this rule to help ensure that natural gas produced on the OCS is accurately measured and reported," MMS Director Cynthia Quarterman said in a statement.
"Most of the production in the OCS is natural gas, and even a one percent measurement or reporting uncertainty could result in royalty revenue variations of $15 million per year," Quarterman said.
